audit.summary: Affine positive-root/cone descriptions omit the affine simple root; invariant integer gradings are incorrectly characterized as0/1 indicator functions. No core theorem failure established.
limitations: Counterevidence: Section6 explicitly uses alpha0 bar=-highest root; Proposition4.3 uses monomial degrees, not false finite-projection positivity.
Counterevidence: The subsequent specified tau-minimal and principal gradings are0/1 and invariant.
Limitations: Complete body reading does not constitute complete proof certification.
Limitations: External universal-K, Borel irreducibility and classification results were not independently reproved.
Limitations: No equivalence with published journal version assumed.
Limitations: No independent acceptance or human review.

Counterevidence: Source page 26 expressly sends alpha0 to -theta. Pages 18-19 prove finite-dimensional descent with monomial counts in affine generators; they do not use positivity of finite projection. Rank-one fixed-lattice consequence also follows from rank and primitive delta.
Counterevidence: The same source page then expressly restricts subsequent work to its tau-minimal 0/1 grading; this selected grading and the principal grading obey the necessary invariant condition.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.
